actions.title: Cancel Subscription
actions.description: Cancel an existing subscription for a customer.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer owning the subscription (cst_...).

subscriptionId.description: The ID of the subscription to cancel (sub_...).

testmode.description: Set to true when using a test API key and you need to target test data.

actions.title: Create Customer
actions.description: Creates a simple minimal representation of a customer.

name.description: The full name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

locale.description: The customer’s locale, e.g. en_US, nl_NL.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to store with the customer (JSON object).

testmode.description: Set to true when using a test API key and you need to target test data.

actions.title: Create Mandate
actions.description: Create a mandate for a specific customer (IBAN or PayPal). Mandates allow you to charge a customer recurrently.

method.description: Payment method for the mandate. Allowed: directdebit or paypal.

consumerBic.description: BIC of the consumer’s bank (optional for directdebit).

paypalBillingAgreementId.description: PayPal Billing Agreement ID (for PayPal mandates).

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Subscription
actions.description: Create a subscription to schedule recurring payments for a customer.

amount.description: Amount to charge for each interval.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. EUR.

value.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "10.00".

interval.description: Interval for charges, e.g. "1 month", "2 weeks".

times.description: Number of charges, or null for infinite.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL for subscription payment events.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Payment
actions.description: Creates a new payment.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. EUR.

value.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "10.00".

description.description: A description shown to the customer.

redirectUrl.description: Redirect URL after the payment completes.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to receive payment status updates.

method.description: Preferred payment method, e.g. ideal, creditcard. Leave empty to allow customer choice.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Payment Link
actions.description: Creates a new payment link.

description.description: Description of what the payment link is for.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. EUR.

value.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "15.00".

redirectUrl.description: URL the customer is sent to after payment.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL for payment status updates.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date-time for the payment link (RFC3339).

profileId.description: Profile ID to create the link on (pfl_...).

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Payment Refund
actions.description: Creates a refund for a specific payment.

amount.description: Amount to refund. Omit for full refund.

currency.description: Currency of the refund, must match payment.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Shipment
actions.description: Creates a new shipment for specific order lines of an order.

lines.description: Order lines to include in this shipment.

quantity.description: Quantity to ship for this line.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Order
actions.description: Creates a new order.

vatRate.description: VAT rate percentage as a string.

method.description: Preferred payment method for order payment.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.

actions.title: Create Order Refund
actions.description: Creates a refund for a specific order.

amount.description: Amount to refund for the line.

testmode.description: Set to true to target test data.
